rows.q: How much notice do I need to give before moving out?
rows.answer: You need to give at least thirty days’ notice, as stated in [§14].  Landlord may increase rent for renewal, as detailed in [§15].  The lease requires a minimum notice period of sixty days before a renewal term begins, as outlined in [§13].

rows.q: Can my landlord come in whenever they want?
rows.answer: The lease states that management must provide at least twenty-four (24) hours’ notice before entering the unit, [§A2].  Landlord may enter the unit at any time upon reasonable notice to inspect, make repairs, or show the unit to prospective tenants, [§9].  However, the lease doesn’t explicitly allow for unlimited entry [§A9].

rows.q: What happens if I pay rent a few days late?
rows.answer: The lease states that a late fee of $150 is due if rent is not received by the 5th day of the month. [§13]  Additionally, a $15 per day charge is added to the rent until it’s paid in full. [§A3]  The tenant is required to pay $2,150 per month, due on the 1st of each month. [§3]

rows.q: How much notice do I need to give before moving out?
rows.answer: You need to give the Landlord at least thirty (30) days' written notice before vacating at the end of the term [§14]. This applies when you are vacating at the end of the term [§14].

rows.q: Can my landlord come in whenever they want?
rows.answer: The management will provide at least twenty-four (24) hours' notice before entering a unit, except in an emergency [§A2]. The landlord may enter the unit at any time upon reasonable notice to inspect, make repairs, or show the unit to prospective tenants [§9].

rows.q: What happens if I pay rent a few days late?
rows.answer: If rent is not received by the 5th day of the month, you will pay a late fee of $150, plus $15 per day until the rent is paid in full [§4]. Rent received after the 3rd day of the month is considered late and subject to late charges [§A3].
